description: QGEP is an open-source software project listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Water", published or maintained by qgep (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). A waste-water application based on QGIS in compliance with SIA-405. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "Water" (water resources). The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (repository not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water resources studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
